name: Marketplace Project
description: A freelance project posted by a client, shown by card-project.php, project-detail.php, and the projects.php catalog. 'proposals_count' was already removed from the live UI in a prior pass (it is now derived by counting Marketplace Proposal rows, not stored).

fields.label: Client
fields.description: Linked to User directly, not to Marketplace Profile — a project poster is a client/business, not necessarily a listed service provider. Avoids inventing a second client-account entity. Public pages show client_display_name instead. Permlevel 1: hidden from Guest (public /api/resource reads); only System Manager and Marketplace Moderator see it.

fields.label: Client Display Name
fields.description: Public label shown on the card, e.g. 'متجر أزياء إلكتروني' — intentionally not the client's real account name, matching current anonymized display in card-project.php/project-detail.php.

fields.label: Client Type
fields.description: Exact literal values already used as client_type across Dummy_Data_Provider::all_projects().

fields.label: Escrow Protected
fields.description: Drives the 'دفع محمي Escrow' badge shown conditionally on card-project.php and project-detail.php.

fields.label: Publication Status
fields.description: Dummy data only ever used 'open'; Closed/Archived are added because a real project marketplace needs to stop accepting proposals once filled or expired.

fields.label: Closed At
fields.description: First time the project was closed (e.g. by accepting a proposal). Never overwritten.

fields.label: Support Note
fields.description: Why the support team closed the project (freelance/api.py support_close_project). Set by the server.
